deal.en: It hasn't been easy for Tom to deal with Mary's health problems.
deal.zh: 处理玛丽的健康问题对汤姆来说不容易。

doubt.en: I doubt that Tom will ever learn how to speak French properly.
doubt.zh: 我对汤姆要持之以恒地学习法语口语这件事很怀疑。

dream.en: Do you ever dream about flying through the sky?
dream.zh: 你曾经梦想在天空飞翔吗？

danger.en: The red flag indicated the presence of danger.

delicious.en: The food in the cafeteria is cheap, and it's delicious.
delicious.zh: 餐厅的饭很便宜，而且很好吃。

drunk.en: A drunk driver was responsible for the car accident.
drunk.zh: 喝醉的驾驶员对车祸有责任。

deserve.en: You don't deserve the salary they're paying you.
deserve.zh: 你不应该得到他们给你的薪水。

death.en: Do you know how many people in the world starve to death every year?
death.zh: 你知不知道全世界每年有多少人饿死呀？

dictator.en: The poor people were at the mercy of the cruel dictator.
dictator.zh: 可怜的人民任凭残暴的独裁者处置。

decision.en: His decision to retire surprised all of us.
decision.zh: 他要退休的决定让我们都感到吃惊。

damage.en: Our employees are working around the clock to fix the damage caused by the ice storm.
damage.zh: 我们的员工正在争分夺秒地修理冰暴带来的损坏。

diary.en: She has kept a diary for 3 years.
diary.zh: 她已经写了三年的日记。

drop.en: Be sure to drop us a line as soon as you get to London.
drop.zh: 别忘了一到伦敦就给我们留言啊。

disagree.en: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.
disagree.zh: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。

dumb.en: Helen Keller was blind, deaf and dumb.
dumb.zh: 海伦凯勒眼盲，耳聋，又哑。

dying.en: Let's eat now. I'm dying of hunger.

drawing.en: She succeeded in drawing the truth from him.
drawing.zh: 她成功地从他口中得知了真相。

dangerous.en: Tom wants to learn boxing, but his mother thinks it's too dangerous.
dangerous.zh: 汤姆想学拳击，但他妈妈觉得这太危险了。

disaster.en: It sounds as if he were to blame for the disaster.
disaster.zh: 听起来好像他是这场灾难的罪魁祸首。

decent.en: Tom is a decent sort of guy.

duty.en: There was only one warden on duty when the riot started.
duty.zh: 暴动开始时只有一位监狱长值班。

disappoint.en: Tom didn't want to disappoint Mary.

drawer.en: Tom took a spatula out of the drawer.
drawer.zh: 汤姆从抽屉里拿出一把锅铲。

daily.en: Most people write about their daily life.
daily.zh: 大部分人写的东西是关于他们的日常生活的。

dare.en: Tom wouldn't dare show his face around here again.
dare.zh: 汤姆不敢再到这里露面。

dove.en: There's a white dove on the roof.

debt.en: All you have to do is ask him to pay the debt.
debt.zh: 你只需要喊他还债就行。

document.en: This document was actually written by Tom.
document.zh: 这文件其实是汤姆写的。

definitely.en: Tom says that Mary definitely won't accept the job.
definitely.zh: 汤姆说玛丽绝不会接受这工作。

depression.en: After Tom lost his job, he started to gamble to cope with his depression.
depression.zh: 汤姆失业后，为了排遣郁闷的心情而开始了赌博。

deaf.en: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
deaf.zh: 善良是聋子能听盲人能看的语言。

dentist.en: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.
dentist.zh: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。

deny.en: We can't deny the fact that he's honest.
deny.zh: 我们无法否认，他确实是很诚实的人。

downstairs.en: Someone is waiting for you downstairs.

dawn.en: It was before dawn that they got the fire under control.
dawn.zh: 他们在黎明前控制住了火势。

disease.en: The number of people suffering from heart disease has increased.
disease.zh: 遭受心脏病困扰的人数增加了。

dozen.en: Several dozen young people participated in the demonstration.
dozen.zh: 几十个年轻人参加了示威游行。

diamond.en: This might not be a genuine diamond.

delete.en: I wish I could figure out how to delete my Facebook account.
delete.zh: 我希望我能知道如何删除我的Facebook帐号。

depend.en: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
depend.zh: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。

difference.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?
difference.zh: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？

draft.en: I am writing a draft of the speech.

divide.en: Let's divide this money between you and me.

deliver.en: Please deliver it to this address.
deliver.zh: 你能把它送到这个地址吗？

dirt.en: The children were playing in the dirt.

difficulty.en: I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.

dial.en: In the case of fire, dial 119.

dump.en: Is Tom going to dump Mary?

discussion.en: They came up with a plan after a long discussion.
discussion.zh: 他们终于在漫长的讨论之后得出了一个计划。

discount.en: Tom sells T-shirts at a 30 percent discount.

drama.en: They made the novel into a drama.
drama.zh: 他们把这本小说变成戏剧。

disposal.en: My car is at your disposal.

directly.en: I got the information from him directly.
directly.zh: 我直接从他那里得到讯息。

divine.en: To err is human, to forgive divine.

desert.en: The Sahara is a vast desert.

democracy.en: He doesn't have any knowledge about American democracy.
democracy.zh: 他一点都不知道美国的民主。

dust.en: Probably you are allergic to pollen or dust.
dust.zh: 你可能对花粉或灰尘过敏。

disturb.en: I'll try not to disturb you while you're studying.
disturb.zh: 我会尽量不打扰你复习。

divorce.en: Marriage is the main cause of divorce.
divorce.zh: 婚姻是造成离婚的主因。

dessert.en: I'm trying to save room for dessert.

dorm.en: Have you gotten used to living in the dorm?
dorm.zh: 你习惯在宿舍生活了吗？

demand.en: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.
demand.zh: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。

depart.en: How often do the buses depart?
depart.zh: 公共汽车多久发车一次？

despite.en: Despite his riches, he's not contented.
despite.zh: 尽管他很富有，他还是不满足。

distance.en: The traveler was delighted at the sight of a light in the distance.
distance.zh: 发现了远处的灯光的旅行者欢喜不已。

diet.en: We're going to eat a lot tonight so I hope you're not on a diet.
diet.zh: 我们今晚会吃很多，所以我希望你没有在节食。

desire.en: There are no people who don't desire peace.

director.en: They appointed him as a director.

direction.en: You have a really good sense of direction.

declare.en: Do you have anything to declare?
declare.zh: 你有任何要申报的东西吗？

degree.en: He got a master's degree in law.
degree.zh: 他得到了法律硕士学位。

discourage.en: I didn't mean to discourage you.

department.en: First off, I'd like you to come with me to a department store sale.
department.zh: 首先，我要你跟我一起去百货公司的特价活动。

due.en: Due to the worsening weather, the departure was delayed.
due.zh: 由于天气变差，出发延迟了。

data.en: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.
data.zh: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。

discover.en: Call me if you discover anything.
discover.zh: 如果你发现什么，请打给我。

describe.en: Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?
describe.zh: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？

detail.en: He described the incident in detail.
detail.zh: 他详细地描述了事故状况。

detective.en: She employed a private detective to keep a watch on her husband.
detective.zh: 她雇了一个私人侦探看守她的丈夫。

deceive.en: It's wrong to deceive people, but worse to deceive yourself.
deceive.zh: 欺骗别人是错的, 但更糟的欺骗自己。

deed.en: His brave deed earned him respect.
deed.zh: 他的英勇行为使他赢得了尊重。

donate.en: How much money do you donate every year?

distant.en: Tom is a distant relative of mine.

damp.en: The weather was not only cold, it was also damp.

doubtful.en: I am doubtful whether he will come.

dusk.en: The children returned home at dusk.
dusk.zh: 夜幕降临时，孩子们回家了。

devil.en: The man sold his soul to the devil.

depth.en: We measured the depth of the river.
depth.zh: 我们测量了这条河的深度。

destination.en: They made straight for their destination.

distinguish.en: I think to clearly distinguish opinion from fact is important.
distinguish.zh: 我认为辨别清楚意见和事实很重要。

dialog.en: I did not participate in the dialog.

density.en: Japan has a high population density.

dye.en: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.
dye.zh: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。

despise.en: The rich sometimes despise the poor.
despise.zh: 富人有时会看不起穷人。

deputy.en: He will be my deputy while I am away.
deputy.zh: 我不在的时候，他将是我的代理人。

dependent.en: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
dependent.zh: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。

dome.en: What's the number for the Tokyo Dome?
dome.zh: 东京巨蛋的电话号码是多少？

device.en: You should have shown him the device.
device.zh: 你应该给他看看这装置。

distract.en: Don't distract me while I am studying.
distract.zh: 我学习的时候不要打扰我。

dim.en: I have a dim memory of my grandmother.
dim.zh: 我对祖母的记忆很模糊。

delay.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
delay.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

district.en: The typhoon struck the Kanto district.

decrease.en: This medicine will decrease your pain.
decrease.zh: 这种药会减轻你的疼痛。

destiny.en: Everyone ought to be the master of his own destiny.
destiny.zh: 每个人都应该做自己命运的主人。

decay.en: Salt helps to preserve food from decay.
decay.zh: 盐可以帮助保存食物避免腐烂。

digital.en: My cell phone has a built-in digital camera.
digital.zh: 我的手机有内建的数位相机。

definite.en: I cannot give you a definite answer today.
definite.zh: 我今天无法给您一个最终的答复。

division.en: The children haven't studied division yet.

differ.en: I'm afraid that I differ with you on this point.
differ.zh: 恐怕就这点上，我和你持不同意见。

defendant.en: The defendant will appeal to a higher court.
defendant.zh: 被告会向上级法院上诉。

decorate.en: Many people decorate their homes for Christmas.
decorate.zh: 许多人都会在圣诞节期间装饰自己的家。

disorder.en: Tom thinks that Mary may have an eating disorder.
disorder.zh: 汤姆认为玛丽可能有进食障碍。

description.en: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
description.zh: 你看过富士山吗? 它美得无法形容。

dam.en: This dam supplies us with water and electricity.
dam.zh: 这个水坝给我们提供水和电。

departure.en: With the weather getting worse, the departure was put off.
departure.zh: 由于天气变差，出发延迟了。

deadly.en: The tip of the spear was dipped in a deadly poison.
deadly.zh: 矛尖浸在一种致命的毒药里。

disappearance.en: We have to look into the disappearance of the doctor.
disappearance.zh: 我们必须调查医生的失踪案。

direct.en: Are there any direct flights between Boston and Sydney?
direct.zh: 请问波士顿和悉尼之间有直飞航班吗？

dash.en: His record is a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
dash.zh: 他刷新了百米短跑的世界纪录。

diplomatic.en: There must be a way to arrive at a diplomatic solution.
diplomatic.zh: 必须有外交解决的途径。

deposit.en: Some people do not like to deposit their money in banks.
deposit.zh: 有些人不喜欢把钱存银行。

disable.en: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.
disable.zh: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。

disagreement.en: It's clear that there's a rather strong disagreement between the two.
disagreement.zh: 很明显的是这两者之间有很强烈的分歧。

desirable.en: It is the things that we do not possess which seem to us most desirable.
desirable.zh: 得不到的东西就最想得到。

display.en: Sociopaths rarely display remorse or feelings of guilt for their crimes.
display.zh: 反社会者极少为他们的罪行显露懊悔或有罪恶的感觉。

determine.en: When people meet, first impressions determine more than 50 percent of whatever happens next.
determine.zh: 在人际交往中，第一印象决定着将要发生的事情内容的百分之五十以上。
